selection.hint: Space selects the row, Shift and an arrow extend the selection, Escape lifts it. Alt+Shift and an arrow move it — Alt+Shift+Up and Alt+Shift+Down by a rank, Alt+Shift+Right and Alt+Shift+Left indenting and outdenting it —, as dragging the handle with the mouse does.
selection.count: {count, plural, one {# row selected} other {# rows selected}}

moved.indented: {others, plural, =0 {“{label}” indented.} one {“{label}” and the next row indented.} other {“{label}” and the # next rows indented.}}
moved.outdented: {others, plural, =0 {“{label}” outdented.} one {“{label}” and the next row outdented.} other {“{label}” and the # next rows outdented.}}
moved.up: {others, plural, =0 {“{label}” moved up a rank.} one {“{label}” and the next row moved up a rank.} other {“{label}” and the # next rows moved up a rank.}}
moved.down: {others, plural, =0 {“{label}” moved down a rank.} one {“{label}” and the next row moved down a rank.} other {“{label}” and the # next rows moved down a rank.}}
moved.dropped: {others, plural, =0 {“{label}” moved.} one {“{label}” and the next row moved.} other {“{label}” and the # next rows moved.}}

structure.deleteHint: “{label}” is a summary: its subordinate tasks, their lines and their links are deleted with it.
structure.timelineHint: Name the timeline. The task, and those of the selection, are inscribed to it.
structure.tracked: {others, plural, =0 {Timelines of “{label}” updated.} one {Timelines of “{label}” and of one other task updated.} other {Timelines of “{label}” and of # other tasks updated.}}
structure.subprojectSet: {others, plural, =0 {Subproject of “{label}” updated.} one {Subproject of “{label}” and of one other line updated.} other {Subproject of “{label}” and of # other lines updated.}}
structure.taskHint: Name the task. It is created as a leaf, automatic, of one day, without predecessor.
structure.lineHint: Choose the category and the quantity of the line. The other fields are entered in the grid.
structure.composedLabel: Optional: by default, the label of the task that bears the line, followed by that of its role.
structure.busy: Waits for the write under way to end.

paste.title: Paste from a spreadsheet
paste.block: Block of {rows, plural, one {# row} other {# rows}} by {columns, plural, one {# column} other {# columns}}, from row {row}, column “{column}”: nothing is written before you confirm.
paste.accepted: {count, plural, =0 {No row will be written.} one {# row will be written.} other {# rows will be written.}}
paste.partial: Confirmed, the paste writes the valid rows, and not the refused ones; abandoned, it changes no row.
paste.rejected: {count, plural, one {# row is refused:} other {# rows are refused:}}
paste.rejectedListed: {count, plural, one {# row is refused, listed below.} other {# rows are refused, listed below.}}
paste.rejectedCount: {count, plural, one {# row was refused.} other {# rows were refused.}}
paste.appliedFrom: Paste applied from row {row}, column “{column}”: {count, plural, =0 {no row was written} one {# row was written} other {# rows were written}}.
paste.waiting: Saving in the grid: the paste applies once that write is done.
paste.hiddenColumn: The pasted block would reach under the column “{column}”, which is hidden: show it before pasting, or paste a narrower block.
paste.absentColumn: The pasted block would reach the column “{column}”, which this grid does not present: paste a narrower block.
paste.foldedRows: The pasted block would reach folded rows: unfold them before pasting, or paste a shorter block.
paste.sortedRows: The pasted block would write the rows that follow the cell in the order of the plan, which the sort has moved: lift the sort before pasting, or paste a shorter block.
paste.unretainedRows: The pasted block would write rows of the plan that the search or the filter hides: lift the search or the filter before pasting, or paste a shorter block.
paste.beyondRows: The pasted block would reach past the rows the grid shows under the cell: paste a shorter block.

period.invertedDefault: The end of the period may not precede its default start, {minimum}.
period.lateDefault: The start of the period may not follow its default end, the date of calculation, {maximum}.

timelines.empty: No task of this revision is inscribed to this timeline.
timelines.formHint: A timeline bears a name, which others may share; the tasks and milestones are inscribed to it afterwards, from the planning.
timelines.deleteHint: The timeline and its inscriptions will be deleted; the tasks and milestones keep their dates.

chart.name: Frieze of the timeline “{name}”
chart.hint: The left and right arrows go from one task to the next; Alt and the up and down arrows move it to another lane. A task may be dragged with the mouse too.
chart.overlap: “{task}” would overlap “{other}” in lane {lane}: it stays in lane {from}.
chart.top: “{task}” is already in the first lane.
chart.bottom: “{task}” is alone in the last lane.
chart.restacked: The tasks of the timeline are laid out automatically.

matrix.none: No risk to draw for this filter.

workload.none: No load on the perimeter and horizon chosen.
workload.chartTitle: Stacked load by role and by month

workload.capacityNote: Capacity of the perimeter: {hours} h per month.

pilotHealth.none: No signal: the control of the projects of the perimeter is kept up.

detail.reviewOverdue: {weeks, plural, one {# week} other {# weeks}} since the last marked revision

costCurve.descriptionDelayed: The same curves, each project shifted by its payment delays and bearing the provisions of its identified risks: the cumulative cash-out of the portfolio, past and to come.

cashOut.exportTitle: Cash-out of the portfolio by month
cashOut.description: The cash-out reading of the portfolio S-curve: the past cash-out, sums of the actual costs of the projects by month of shifted document date, and the cash-out to come, sums of their shifted projections, month by month.

portfolio.periodRefused: The view is not read: the server refuses the period asked.

remainingSummary.bySubproject: Remaining to commit by sub-project, and margin on the budget

kanban.summary: The tasks of the revision in progress, not started, started and completed. A task is started or it is not: no percentage is entered.
kanban.inProgressOnly: The Kanban presents the tasks of the revision in progress: a marked revision has none to start.
kanban.milestoneDue: Its predecessors are completed: milestone to complete.
kanban.keys: Arrows: choose a card. Enter: open the menu of its gestures. Shift + right or left arrow: carry it to the neighbouring column. A card can also be dragged to another column, or moved by its menu.
kanban.unplaced: {label}: the answer does not say which column the task is in; the tasks are read again.
kanban.dateRequired: Enter the date of the event.
kanban.noGesture: No gesture leads this task to the column “{column}”.
kanban.asking: A date is already asked on another task: enter it or give it up before asking this gesture.

contextBanner.label: Reading context
contextBanner.readOnly: Read only: no entry is offered on this revision.

notInProgress.title: Indicators unavailable
notInProgress.explanation: The indicators of a project are computed from the In progress state; before, only the indicators of the estimate exist.

unknownScope.title: Indicators unavailable
unknownScope.explanation: The subproject asked for does not exist in this project: no indicator is computed for it. Remove the filter of the subproject, or choose another one.

elsewhere.title: Computed on another revision
elsewhere.history: The evolution of the indices is computed on the revision “{revision}”, not on the one of the indicators.

projections.title: Projection at completion
projections.varianceAtObservedRate: Variance from budget of the projection at the observed rate: {variance}

history.costDescription: Curves of the cost index of the project and of each of its scopes, one point per marked revision and the last at the current day, with the watch threshold at {watch} and the alert threshold at {alert}.
history.scheduleDescription: Curves of the schedule index of the project and of each of its scopes, one point per marked revision and the last at the current day, with the watch threshold at {watch} and the alert threshold at {alert}.

milestones.title: Milestone tracking
milestones.description: For each tracked milestone, the date each marked revision forecast, by the date of its marking, and the last point at the current day, with the diagonal of equal dates.

costCurve.title: Cumulative costs
costCurve.description: Cumulative curves of the reference budget by the dates of the reference, of the actual cost by the document dates up to the calculation date, then of the project manager’s projection, with the dated steps of the reference budget.
costCurve.descriptionDelayed: The same curves shifted by the payment delay of each line, the provisions of the identified risks added at the date of their task: the cash out, past and to come.
costCurve.undelay: Remove the shift by the payment delays

earnedValue.title: Earned value curves
earnedValue.chartTitle: Planned value, earned value and actual cost
earnedValue.description: Cumulative curves of the planned value, extended to the end of the reference, of the earned value by the completion dates and of the actual cost by the document dates, up to the calculation date.

curves.empty: Nothing to draw: no line and no actual cost belong to this scope.
curves.seriesEmpty: {series}: nothing to draw for this scope.

wholeProject.milestones: This tracking covers the whole project: it follows milestones, which a subproject does not have.

provenance.wholeProject: Whole project, not restricted to the filtered subproject

workload.title: Project workload
workload.chartTitle: Load by role and by month
workload.description: Stacked bars of the load of each resource role by month, in hours; the monthly capacity of each role is in the table of the values, against its load.
workload.none: No role has a load on this basis.
workload.noneInNode: No role of the node “{node}” or of its descendants has a load on this basis.

refused.noReference: The workload is not available on this basis: the project has no reference revision, and only the current revision is one.
refused.markedRevision: The workload is not available on this basis: the marked revision asked for is missing, or is not marked.
refused.orgNode: The workload is not available: the organisation node asked for does not exist.
refused.invalid: The workload is not available: the API refuses what is asked.

workload.exportDetail: Basis: {basis} · Organisation node and its descendants: {node}

undo.help: Undoes the last entry of the revision.

columns.help: Chooses the columns the grid shows.

outline.help: Folds or unfolds the whole tree, or folds it down to a level.

expandAll.help: Unfolds every row of the tree.

collapseAll.help: Folds the tree onto its rows of the first level.

collapseRow.help: Folds the row: the rows under it are hidden.

expandRow.help: Unfolds the row: the rows under it are shown.

insertFirst.help: Creates the first task of the structure.

insertBelow.help: Creates a task below the row, at the same level.

insertChild.help: Creates a sub-task under the task of the row.

insertLine.help: Creates an estimate line on the task, or below the line.

indent.help: Makes the row a subordinate of the one before it.

outdent.help: Moves the row one level up the tree.

up.help: Moves the row one place up among its siblings.

down.help: Moves the row one place down among its siblings.

delete.help: Deletes the row; a summary takes its subordinates with it, once confirmed.

zoomIn.help: Narrows the time scale to read the dates more closely.
zoomIn.unavailable: The zoom is at its closest.

zoomOut.help: Widens the time scale to see a longer period.
zoomOut.unavailable: The zoom is at its widest.

fit.help: Fits the scale to show the whole project.
fit.unavailable: The scale already shows the whole project.

exportGantt.help: Saves the Gantt as a PNG image, over its whole extent at the zoom level chosen, with the project, the revision and the date of calculation.
exportGantt.unavailableWidth: The image would be too wide for the browser: zoom out.
exportGantt.unavailableHeight: The image would be too tall for the browser: fold some summaries.
exportGantt.unavailableArea: The image would be too large for the browser: zoom out, or fold some summaries.

restack.help: Stacks the tasks in their lanes by themselves, forgetting those chosen by hand.
restack.unavailable: No task was placed by hand: they are stacked by themselves.

dismissNews.help: Removes this line; the task stays followed in the panel of the tasks and messages.

startedOnly.help: Shows or hides the tasks not started.

timelines.help: Opens the timelines of the project, as a frieze.

exchanges.help: Opens the imports and exports of the revision.

taskTree.help: Opens the task tree of the revision.

workload.help: Opens the workload of the revision, by role.

addMappingLabel.help: Adds a label to the list; it is saved only with the mapping.

removeMappingLabel.help: Removes the label from the list; it is erased only when the mapping is saved.

openActualCostMapping.help: Opens the mapping of the columns of the actual cost extraction.

kanban.help: Opens the kanban of the tasks to do, in progress and done.

modify.help: Opens the form that modifies the row.

deactivate.help: Deactivates the object: it is no longer offered to new entries, but its data stay.

reactivate.help: Reactivates the object: it is offered to entries again.

designateCalendar.help: Makes this calendar the one new resources use by default.

retainBackup.help: Marks the backup to keep: retention does not delete it.

releaseBackup.help: Lifts the mark to keep: retention may delete the backup again.

restoreBackup.help: Opens the restoration of the platform from this backup, after confirmation.

deleteRole.help: Deletes the access role, after confirmation.

resend_invitation.help: Has the identity provider send again the email that carries the password setup link of a local account.

password_link.help: Gives the link by which the account holder sets a password.

anonymize.help: Anonymises the deactivated account, after confirmation: the operation is final.

activeUser.help: Activates or deactivates the account: a deactivated account can no longer sign in.

update.help: Opens the form of the settings of the project.

manage_contributors.help: Manages the contributors of the project.

create_revision.help: Creates the revision being drawn up, a copy of the last marked revision.

generate_skeleton.help: Generates the skeleton of the planning of the revision.

lose.help: Declares the project lost, after confirmation.

declare_risk_occurrence.help: Declares that a risk occurred and records its account, after confirmation.

import_actual_costs.help: Imports the actual costs from a file.

import_planning.help: Imports a planning from an MS Project file.

import_estimate.help: Imports an estimate from a file.

import_remaining.help: Imports a remaining to commit from a file.

generate_skeleton.help: Generates the skeleton of the planning of the revision.

declare_risk.help: Declares a new risk on the project.

create_structure.help: Prepares an amendment: a differential structure on the revision.

merge_structure.help: Makes the amendment contractual: its differences join the main structure.

mark.help: Marks the revision: it becomes a frozen, named version.

designate_reference.help: Designates the marked revision as the reference budget, after confirmation.

abandon.help: Abandons the revision being drawn up, after confirmation.

deleteRisk.help: Deletes the risk with its own estimate and its provision line, after confirmation.

modifyRisk.help: Opens the form that modifies the risk.

reviewRisk.help: Opens the review of the risk.

planningStart.help: Changes the planning start date of the structure, after confirmation: the server redates the automatic tasks that depend on it.

updateRates.help: Replaces the rates of the revision in progress by the rates proposed, for the categories retained, after confirmation.

excludeCostLine.help: Excludes the cost line from the tracked scope.

reinstateCostLine.help: Reinstates the cost line in the tracked scope.

applyReport.help: Applies the import to the revision, after confirmation.

abandonReport.help: Abandons the import: nothing is applied.

deleteTimeline.help: Deletes the timeline shown; its milestones go with it.

cardGestures.help: Opens the menu of the gestures of this task.

retryReading.help: Reads the tasks of this card again.

contributorWithdraw.help: Removes this contributor from the list to save.

contributorInscribe.help: Adds this account to the list to save, as a contributor.

breakdownWorkPackage.help: Adds a work package to the work breakdown of the project.

breakdownAdd.help: Adds an order item to this work package, or a deliverable to this order item.

breakdownRename.help: Changes the label of this element of the work breakdown.

breakdownDelete.help: Deletes this element of the work breakdown, with what it holds.

help.help: Opens, beside the screen, the help that describes it: what it shows, its commands, its columns, its keyboard gestures and the notions of the method.

label.help: Label of the task or of the line, at the place it holds in the tree.

category.help: Cost category of the line: it gives the rate and the nature of the expense.

role.help: Resource role that performs the line, when it is effort.

quantity.help: Number of units of the line.

hours.help: Effort of the line, in hours.

unitDisbursement.help: Disbursement of one unit, apart from the effort.

paymentDelay.help: Number of days between the consumption of the line and its payment.

inactiveObject.help: Marks a line that uses a deactivated object of the reference data.

referenceAmount.help: Amount of the line at the reference year of the revision, before any correction for inflation.

reestimatedAmount.help: Re-estimated amount of the line, inflation included: the amount at the reference year ({year}) projected on the year the line is consumed, at the inflation rate of the revision ({rate} a year).

reestimatedAmountStatic.help: Re-estimated amount of the line, inflation included: the amount at the reference year of the revision projected on the year the line is consumed, at the inflation rate of the revision.

schedulingMode.help: Scheduling mode: the task follows its links, or its dates are set by hand.

duration.help: Duration of the task, in the chosen unit.

startDate.help: Start date of the task, computed by the server from its links and the calendar.

finishDate.help: Finish date of the task, computed by the server from its duration and the calendar.

progress.help: Progress of the task: to do, in progress or done.

physicalProgress.help: Share of the work done, as a percentage of the task.

totalFloat.help: Total float: the delay the task can take without pushing the end of the project. A summary bears the smallest float of its subordinates.

startedOn.help: The date the task started on, set by the server when its state changes; a summary bears the first of its started subordinates.

completedOn.help: The date the task was completed on, set by the server when its state changes.

predecessors.help: Tasks this one depends on, named by their row number.

attachment.help: Lot or post of the work breakdown structure the task belongs to.

timelines.help: Timelines the task is inscribed on.

gantt.help: Bar of the task on the time scale.

progress.help: Progress of the task: to do, in progress or done.

finishDate.help: Planned finish date of the task.

finishOverdue.help: Marks a task whose planned finish has passed without it being done.

budgetedAmount.help: Budgeted amount of the line, as the reference budget froze it.

previousQuantity.help: Quantity of the line at the previous remaining to commit.

previousHours.help: Effort of the line, in hours, at the previous remaining to commit.

previousUnitDisbursement.help: Unit disbursement of the line at the previous remaining to commit.

previousReestimatedAmount.help: Re-estimated amount of the line at the previous remaining to commit.

quantity.help: Quantity left to commit on the line.

hours.help: Effort left to commit on the line, in hours.

unitDisbursement.help: Unit disbursement of the line, re-estimated.

reestimatedAmount.help: Re-estimated amount of the line or task: the updated estimate at completion.

label.help: Label of the risk, as it was identified.

probability.help: Probability that the risk occurs, as a percentage.

severity.help: Severity: what the risk would cost if it occurred, the total of its own estimate, computed by the server.

provisionAmount.help: Provision: for an identified risk, the severity weighted by the probability; for a risk that occurred or was dismissed, the provision it bore in the reference revision. Computed by the server.

occurrenceCost.help: Cost at occurrence of a risk that occurred: the total of its own estimate when it was declared occurred, which neither reestimates nor the completion of its tasks change. Computed by the server.

state.help: State of the risk: identified, occurred or dismissed.

lastReview.help: Date of the last review of the risk.

matrixCell.help: Cell of the risk matrix its probability and severity fall in, and the zone that colours it.

lastName.help: Last name of the holder of the account; an anonymised account has none any more.

firstName.help: First name of the holder of the account.

email.help: Email address of the account, at which it receives its invitation.

origin.help: Where the account comes from: created in Waterfall, imported from the directory or created by the identity provider.

attachment.help: Node of the organisation the account is attached to.

accessRoles.help: Access roles the account holds: they give it its permissions.

state.help: State of the account: a deactivated account stays listed, but can no longer sign in.

resend_invitation.help: Email of the link by which the holder of a local account sets its password, sent again by the identity provider.

password_link.help: Link by which the holder of a local account sets their password.

anonymize.help: Anonymisation of a deactivated account: its last name, first name and address are erased, for good.

roleKind.help: Kind of the role: predefined at installation, or composed by an administrator.

holders.help: Number of accounts that hold the role.

delete.help: Deletion of the role, possible as long as no account holds it.

createdAt.help: Date and time the row was created, in the time of this workstation.

createdBy.help: Account that created the row, or the platform for an automatic process.

updatedAt.help: Date and time the row was last modified, in the time of this workstation.

updatedBy.help: Account that last modified the row, or the platform for an automatic process.

occurredAt.help: Date and time of the action recorded, in the time of this workstation.

author.help: Account that acted, under the name it bore then, or the platform.

action.help: Action recorded in the journal, and under it what it did to its object.

objectKind.help: Kind of the object the action concerns.

object.help: Object the action concerns, under the name it bore then.

objectHistory.help: Every entry that concerns the same object.

project.help: Project of the object, or « No project ».

correlation.help: Identifier of the request that produced the entry: it links the entries of one request.

takenAt.help: Date and time of the backup, in the time of this workstation.

verification.help: Verification of the backup: pending, passed or failed. Only a verified backup downloads and restores.

origin.help: What started the backup: manual or scheduled.

retention.help: Mark of retention: a backup marked to be kept escapes the rotation.

download.help: Download of the archive of the backup.

restore.help: Restoration of the whole platform from the backup.

label.help: Label of the project; a link opens it when you may consult it.

state.help: State of the project in its life cycle.

currentEstimate.help: Current estimate of a project in pricing.

winProbability.help: Probability of winning a project in pricing.

projectManagerProjection.help: Projection at completion of the project manager, for a project in progress.

deltaToReference.help: Variance of the project manager's projection to the reference budget.

costIndex.help: Cost index of the project, and its zone.

scheduleIndex.help: Schedule index of the project, and its zone.

lastMarkedAt.help: Date of the last marked revision of the project.

state.help: State of the object, active or deactivated, and the command that changes it.

modify.help: Modification of the object, in its form.

code.help: Code of the cost type, unique.

kind.help: Kind of the cost type: labour, non-labour or risk provision; it no longer changes once one of its categories is used, bears a rate or is attached to a role.

costType.help: Cost type the category is attached to, active or not.

accountingCode.help: Accounting code of the category, unique and documentary: it enters no calculation; the files of the estimate and of the remaining to commit name the category of a non-labour line by it.

state.help: State of the category, active or deactivated; it is reactivated in the list of the categories.

year.help: Hourly rate of the category for the year of the column, in the currency of the installation; empty until it is entered.

label.help: Label of the node, indented under the node it is attached to.

level.help: Depth of the node in the tree: 1 for a root.

orgNode.help: Organisation node of the role, set at its creation.

costCategory.help: Labour category of the role, whose hourly rate prices its hours.

calendar.help: Calendar of the role, which gives its working hours of each day.

monthlyHours.help: Hours available a month, alone compared with the workload plan.

headcount.help: Headcount the hours a month stand for.

defaultCalendar.help: The default calendar, a single one among the active ones, or the command that designates the one of the row.

mergeReport.label: Contractualise the amendment
mergeReport.statement: The merge applies the report below to the main structure and marks the current revision under the version name you give; the revision produced becomes the reference, and the reference budget moves. Abandoning here changes nothing.
mergeReport.title: Report of the merge
mergeReport.createsRevision: The project has no revision in progress: the merge first creates it by copying the last marked revision, merges the differential into it and marks it, in the same background task. If it fails, no revision is created.
mergeReport.completed: {count, plural, one {# started task will be completed} other {# started tasks will be completed}}
mergeReport.completedTask: “{label}”: the differential removes it; it is kept, its remaining to commit brought to zero.
mergeReport.refusals: {count, plural, one {# reason refuses the merge} other {# reasons refuse the merge}}
mergeReport.versionNameHint: Required: the revision produced bears it.
mergeReport.queued: The merge is handed to the background worker under the version name “{version}”; it is followed in “Background tasks”.
mergeReport.reference: The merge is done: “{version}” is the new reference revision.

amendment.label: Prepare an amendment
amendment.statement: A differential of the main structure is created under the label given, and opens in the planning grid, where you add and modify tasks and lines. Nothing is merged.
amendment.name: Label of the amendment

abandon.label: Abandon the current revision
abandon.statement: The project returns to its last marked revision, and the lines of the current revision are deleted. The abandon is irreversible: it is not in the history that “Undo” reverts.
abandon.done: The current revision is abandoned: the project is back to its last marked revision.

designate.label: Designate as reference
designate.statement: Designating “{name}” as the reference fixes the reference budget and the planned value of the project. If the project bears its project code, it goes to the state “{state}”.
designate.done: “{name}” is the reference revision: the project is in the state “{state}”.

rateUpdate.label: Apply the rate update
rateUpdate.statement: The rates of the current revision are replaced by the proposed rates, for the categories retained; the amounts of its lines and of its totals are calculated anew. A marked revision keeps the rates it calculated.
rateUpdate.done: {count, plural, one {The rates of # category are updated.} other {The rates of # categories are updated.}}

filter.label: Filter of the list
filter.defaultLabel: Default filter of the list by state

projectList.periodRefused: The list is not read: the server refuses the period asked.

projectStart.title: Start the project
projectStart.lead: The main structure of the current revision has no task. Start the planning one of these ways.
projectStart.skeleton: Automatic planning from the work breakdown
projectStart.skeletonHint: Enter the work breakdown, then generate the planning.
projectStart.importHint: Drop an .xml file: its report comes before it is applied.

generatePlanning.title: Generate the planning
generatePlanning.lead: Once the work breakdown is entered, generate the planning: a summary task for each work package and order item, a task for each deliverable and their end milestones.
generatePlanning.label: Generate the planning

riskForm.identifyHint: The risk opens its own estimate, where its tasks and lines are costed; its provision, computed, is carried by a task of the main structure.
riskForm.modifyHint: The severity and the provision are computed from the own estimate and the probability: they are not entered. The probability changes by a review alone.
riskForm.firstTask: First task of the first level
riskForm.reviewHint: The review is dated today: confirming it with no change still produces one, added to the history. The severity and the provision are computed again.
riskForm.categoryOnReturn: Asked on the return to the identified state: the category the risk designated is no longer active.

riskDelete.label: Delete the risk
riskDelete.statement: The risk is deleted with its own estimate and its line of provision. A risk cited by a marked revision cannot be deleted: it is dismissed by a review.

riskOccurrence.label: Declare occurred
riskOccurrence.statement: The own estimate of the risk is merged into the main structure of the current revision, with a nil budgeted amount, and its line of provision is withdrawn from the remaining to commit. The declaration is final: a risk occurred is no longer modified.
riskOccurrence.queued: The occurrence of “{name}” is handed to the background processing; it is followed in “Background tasks”.
riskOccurrence.succeeded: The occurrence of “{name}” is done: its own estimate is merged into the main structure.

riskOccurrenceReport.title: Report of the occurrence
riskOccurrenceReport.createsRevision: The project has no revision in progress: the occurrence first creates it by copying the last marked revision, and merges the own estimate of the risk into it, in the same background task. If it fails, no revision is created.
riskOccurrenceReport.provision: The line of provision of the risk is withdrawn from the remaining to commit: {amount} of provision less.
riskOccurrenceReport.refusals: {count, plural, one {# reason refuses the occurrence} other {# reasons refuse the occurrence}}

projectForm.createHint: The project is born in the Created state, and you are its project manager. The project code may wait for the order.
projectForm.modifyHint: The inflation rate affects no marked revision.

exitProject.statement: This exit is final: the project will go to the state “{state}”, and it and all its data — plannings, estimates, remaining commitments, actual costs — will become read only. No transition leaves a terminal state.
exitProject.mark: Mark the current revision: it becomes a marked revision, under the version name given.

errors.ACCOUNT_DEACTIVATED: This account is deactivated; contact an administrator.

errors.UNKNOWN_ACCESS_ROLE: This access role does not exist.
errors.UNKNOWN_ORG_NODE: This organisation node does not exist.
errors.FIELD_READ_ONLY: This field comes from the identity provider: it cannot be changed in Waterfall.
errors.BACKUP_FROM_NEWER_VERSION: This backup comes from a newer version than the one installed: it cannot be restored.
errors.TASK_INTERRUPTED_BY_RESTORE: The restoration interrupted this task, under way when the restored backup was taken: it does not resume.
errors.PASTE_TARGET_REMOVED: The target of the paste disappeared in the meantime: nothing was pasted.

errors.AMBIGUOUS_TASK_LABEL: This label is carried by several tasks: the report does not say which one it targets.

ComputedDependency.remaining_reviews: The re-estimated amount follows the reviews of the estimate to complete.

ComputedDependency.own_estimate: The severity of a risk is the total of its own estimate.
ComputedDependency.severity_and_probability: The provision of a risk is its severity weighted by its probability.
ComputedDependency.reference_provision: The provision of a risk that occurred or was dismissed is the one it bore in the reference revision.
ComputedDependency.occurrence_estimate: The cost at occurrence of a risk is the total of its own estimate when it was declared occurred.
